title: 刚出炉的肉桂卷  (Hot Cinnamon Rolls)

segments.t: Back at Courtyard Inn, Teacher Song walks down at seven ten in her cardigan, hoping for hot tea before washing up. Mei and Manager Zhou launch their distraction plan. Listen first.
早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
周经理，看院子窗户外头——有人跑进大门了！
得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
'Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!' Doubling a describing word into
暖暖
makes it sound soft and cosy rather than dryly factual.
其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
'Actually, I came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt a bit cool.' Gentle conversational pivot:
其实
introduces what is really going on—'actually' or 'to be honest'.
凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
'Cool? Ah—yes! Old-street water pipes need a gentle morning warm-up!' Funny sports metaphor:
热身
literally 'warm the body', means 'warm up' before exercise—or here, pipes waking up!
早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
'At seven in the morning, who could say no to piping-hot cinnamon bread.' Lively kitchen word
热乎乎
captures food that feels wonderfully warm and comforting in your hands.
只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？

'Just a little butter, thank you. Manager Zhou, why do you keep looking at your watch?' Placed before an action like 'look at your watch', 'old' shifts meaning to 'always' or 'keep doing it over and over'.
我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
'Me? Oh, I simply love punctuality! Seven fourteen is a lovely minute!' Manager Zhou's obsession in two characters:
准时
joins 'accurate' with 'time' for 'punctual' or 'on time'.
周经理，看院子窗户外头——有人跑进大门了！
'Manager Zhou, look out the courtyard window—someone just ran in the gate!' Directional compound
跑进
glues 'enter' onto 'run' for 'sprint right inside'.
得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
'Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!' Joyful cry
得救
literally 'obtain rescue', means 'we're saved!'. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
其实我下楼是想问问，洗手间水龙头怎么有点凉。
凉？啊——对！老街水管早上需要慢慢热身！
先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
早上七点有热乎乎的肉桂面包，谁会拒绝呢。
太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
只要一点黄油，谢谢。周经理，您怎么老看手表？
我？哦，我只是喜欢准时！七点十四分真美妙！
周经理，看院子窗户外头——有人跑进大门了！
得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
Fresh cinnamon rolls bought the exact ten minutes they needed as Qing dashed back through the front gate. Let's head down to the boiler cellar next time. See you next time.
回头见！
